name: PiKVM V4 Plus
description: The PiKVM V4 Plus is the flagship model offering enterprise-grade features in a sleek, all-in-one design. It supports true HDMI capture with 1080p 60Hz video mode for the best BIOS/UEFI compatibility, full keyboard/mouse emulation, remote ATX power control, and even virtual media.  Whether you're managing datacenter equipment or mission-critical servers, this device is built to handle it. It’s the ultimate tool for sysadmins who need reliable, secure remote access.

FPS.comment: 30 fps by default (1080p); can be unlocked to 60 fps with H.264 ("H.264 boost" mode)

Latency.comment: Officially claimed as the lowest among KVM-over-IP devices

Power Control.comment: Via the included ATX board (power on/off/reset)

Multiport KVM Support.comment: Via the separate PiKVM Switch device (up to 5 ports)

Wi-Fi.comment: Optional — 802.11 b/g/n, requires an external antenna (metal enclosure)

Zero-Config Remote Access.comment: Built-in guides for Tailscale VPN / Cloudflare Tunnel / NetBird, but setup is still required

Event Notifications (Alerting).comment: Prometheus integration is available for monitoring

REST API / Webhooks.comment: The REST HTTP API is documented; webhooks are not offered as a separate feature

Scripting.comment: Via the HTTP API and console utilities (kvmd-*, SSH)

Software Ecosystem & Client.comment: Fully browser-based (no native client), with optional VNC

Software USB Replug.comment: The "Connect Main USB" toggle plus dynamic USB configuration

Audit Trail / Event Logging.comment: System logs (journalctl) and Prometheus metrics; there is no dedicated audit UI

Encrypted Stream (TLS 1.3 / AES-256).comment: HTTPS/WSS by default (self-signed certificate, with Let's Encrypt support); WebRTC is encrypted via DTLS-SRTP

Enterprise Auth (LDAP / AD / SSO).comment: Advanced authentication plugin via PAM: LDAP, SSSD/Active Directory, Kerberos, RADIUS

Session Recording.comment: Only a manual workaround via ffmpeg/websocat for recording silent video is available

IPMI / Redfish Emulation.comment: Native IPMI BMC emulation (kvmd-ipmi, including Serial-over-LAN for the console) and Redfish (power management over HTTP/JSON, works with the standard redfishtool).

Mass Deployment / Auto-Provisioning.comment: A pre-boot configuration mechanism: a pikvm.txt file is placed on the first partition of the SD card, and its parameters (Wi-Fi, etc.) are applied automatically on first boot.

SoC / Processor.status: Broadcom BCM2711, 4× Cortex-A72 @ 1.5 GHz (Raspberry Pi CM4)

Bluetooth.status: Present in hardware on the CM4 + Bluetooth HID software support

Power Consumption.comment: Official Mini idle figure is 2.67W; Plus likely higher due to extra USB3/HDMI/LTE. Peak = PSU rating, not measured

What's Included.comment: ATX board, ATX cables, mounting brackets, Ethernet cable, USB-C-to-USB-A cable, 12V/2A power supply

Additional Accessories.comment: PiKVM Switch (multiport, up to 5 ports) — sold separately; LTE/5G modem — sold separately; external Wi-Fi antenna — sold separately
